summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a docstring covering the three CBD rules, and added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming reification, blank-node non-expansion in reification, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. No commits were made and no tests were run, per the instructions; verification was by reading only. The test fixture is my own, with counts chosen to match the acceptance criteria and hand-computed, so a count mismatch would most likely be a fixture miscount.
